title: No in-editor design token preview
description: When Claude generates UI, there's no quick way to verify the tokens it's using match my actual DESIGN.md definitions without running the app. Need something like a live token inspector or a design toolbar.

title: No default design system for new web apps
description: Claude doesn't guide toward a specific design system when starting a new project. Each project ends up with ad-hoc styles unless you manually set up DESIGN.md first. Need a normalized starting point.
notes: DESIGN.md format is emerging as the answer here. Watching designmd.ai for starter templates.

title: No unified view across projects
description: No way to see async agent tasks running across multiple projects, switch between them, or have a persistent cross-project chat. Have to context-switch manually between terminal windows.
notes: Conductor is closest but macOS only and still evolving.

title: Hard to verify UI output without running the app
description: Agents generate UI code but there's no automated way to verify it looks right. Manual review catches regressions late. Playwright MCP is the most promising solution but requires setup.
notes: Playwright MCP is the current best answer. Need to actually wire it up.

title: Context resets between Claude Code sessions
description: Every new Claude Code session starts fresh. Project context, recent decisions, and ongoing work have to be re-established manually or via CLAUDE.md. Need better cross-session memory patterns.
notes: LLM Wiki pattern (raw/ + wiki/ + schema/) is the most structured approach seen so far. Karpathy's CLAUDE.md is a simpler reference point for instruction persistence without a full wiki setup.

title: No rapid UI/UX design iteration loop
description: There's no fast, low-friction path from design intent to working UI. Going prompt → Figma → Claude Code → browser involves too many manual handoff steps. Need tools that collapse the design-to-code loop so visual iteration can happen at AI speed.
notes: All three are partial solutions — none fully closes the loop yet. Figma Make and Claude Design generate designs from prompts; paper.design focuses on the Figma-to-code handoff side.

title: No established pattern for AFK/overnight Claude usage
description: Running Claude Code for long, unattended tasks (overnight builds, extended agent loops) is unreliable. Two open questions: (1) what are ralph loops actually useful for and where do they break down, and (2) what alternatives exist for tasks ralph loops can't handle — e.g. hooks, sub-agents, scheduled runs.
notes: Ralph loop is a public skill but its scope and failure modes are not well documented. Need to verify the skill exists and test its limits before recommending.
